evidence_policy: Same archived C1 Top-5, all passages retained; source offsets reconstruct quotations; near duplicates are annotated, never counted as independent votes or silently removed.
factored_policy: Plan from query/claim only; answer each fact question in a separate context containing the query and complete evidence, without initial answer, candidate, or other fact answers. Same Qwen weights, not an independent verifier.
fever_policy: SUPPORTS needs evidence for the claim; REFUTES needs explicit contradiction. Insufficient evidence and unresolved relevant conflict retain the initial prediction. Never rewrite the input claim.
nq_policy: Keep valid aliases and equivalent concise answers; repair requires an answer span in selected original evidence. A supported statement must also answer the requested relation and scope.
development_policy: Use already exposed development records only. The consumed challenge125 and historical held-out data cannot select prompts. New unseen data stay unopened until candidate selection and team isolation are fixed.
selection_policy: Assess original-answer false acceptance, correct-answer false rejection, source validity, fixes, regressions and cost by dataset. Unscored human cases stay unscored. Declare the development gate and frozen cohort before GPU submission.
compute_limit: These arms are not compute matched. Report actual calls, tokens and latency; do not attribute gains solely to decomposition or claim efficiency without a separate compute-controlled comparison.
stop_policy: Engineering checks before GPU; no tuning on the old smoke8. Freeze the GPU input/code fingerprint before submission. New unseen evaluation runs once after selection; never tune on its outputs.
promotion_policy: Experimental opt-in entry only; no default strategy promotion or alteration of frozen v7/r3/r4 packages.
